Hints: Multiply both the whole and fractional parts by the whole-number factor, then regroup and simplify.
Solution: Distribute 5 to both parts: 5 x 1 = 5; 5 x 3/5 = 15/5. Combine 5 + 15/5 = 8. As an improper fraction, 1 3/5 = 8/5, so the product is 40/5.
